Starting the MDS program has been an exciting and slightly overwhelming experience. During orientation week, I met my cohort and got a sense of the pace and structure of the program. 
The first week of classes was a mix of excitement and adjustment. What surprised me most was the quality of contents and lectures.
Now two weeks have passed, I'm starting to feel more settled.
